candidates.violated_requirement: The output 'match' should be asserted when the shift register contains the pattern 8'b0111_0001, but the mutant asserts it for 8'b0111_0011 instead. This will cause incorrect matching when the input sequence contains the pattern 8'b0111_0011.
candidates.spec_basis: The specification requires the output 'match' to be asserted only when the shift register matches the specific pattern 8'b0111_0001.
